findings.label: Unauthenticated verify endpoint
findings.detail: GET /payments/verify/:reference has JwtAuthGuard but no ownership check. Any authenticated user who knows a reference string can confirm or cancel another user's booking. Pass userId through verifyAndConfirmPayment and add payment.booking.userId !== userId guard.

findings.label: Payment.status never set to REFUNDED
findings.detail: refundPayment creates a Refund record and calls Paystack but never calls prisma.payment.update to set status to REFUNDED. The payment stays SUCCESS after a refund, breaking all downstream guards that check payment.status !== SUCCESS.

findings.label: cancelBooking not called on refund
findings.detail: The refund flow does not call bookingsService.cancelBooking. The booking stays in CONFIRMED status after a refund is issued. The plan requires this transition.

findings.label: Refund not admin-gated
findings.detail: The controller uses only JwtAuthGuard; the plan specifies SUPER_ADMIN. Any authenticated user can issue a refund on their own booking without admin involvement. Add RolesGuard + @Roles(UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN) or document the deliberate change.

findings.label: Hardcoded commission rate
findings.detail: initializePayment uses Math.round(totalNgn * 0.1) directly. ConfigService is not injected. The rate cannot be changed without a code deploy despite PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE being documented in the README and plan.

findings.label: Refund write ordering
findings.detail: refundPayment calls paystackService.createRefund before prisma.refund.update. If the DB update fails after Paystack succeeds, the refund is processed externally but the local record stays PENDING with no indication it was submitted.

findings.label: Partial-refund amount guard missing
findings.detail: refundPayment does not check dto.amountNgn > payment.amountNgn. An over-amount refund will be sent to Paystack, and if Paystack rejects it the Refund record and Payment.status change have already been persisted, leaving inconsistent state.

findings.label: @IsNotEmpty() missing on VerifyPaymentDto
findings.detail: reference has only @IsString(), so an empty string passes validation and reaches Paystack's verify endpoint. Add @IsNotEmpty().

findings.label: cancelBooking on abandoned — CancelBookingDto shape unverified
findings.detail: verifyAndConfirmPayment passes { reason: 'Payment failed' } inline to cancelBooking for Paystack 'abandoned' status. Confirm this matches CancelBookingDto's required fields; a shape mismatch will throw at runtime.

findings.label: Webhook payload string vs Buffer
findings.detail: handleWebhook converts rawBody to string before signature verification. If rawBody contains non-UTF-8 bytes the HMAC comparison will fail silently. Pass the Buffer directly through to verifyWebhookSignature to remove the encoding dependency.

findings.label: No unit tests
findings.detail: payments.service.spec.ts does not exist. The plan specified a full test matrix covering guard assertions, idempotency, signature rejection, and refund guards. The webhook idempotency and refund ordering gaps would have been caught by tests.
